purpose.text:
Reconfigures PAC proxy routing for corporate endpoints traveling between remote offices.
2. Preconditions
• Workstation is joined to corp.internal Active Directory domain.
• Active VPN tunnel is disconnected before executing PAC file change.
• Administrative rights granted via temporary elevation token.

scope.text: Applies to network operations and authorized agents.
scope.quote: Applies to network operations and authorized agents.

steps.action: Verify DNS resolution for the PAC file host to ensure the autoconfig URL is reachable.
steps.input: try { $pacHost = ([uri]'{{entities.pac_url}}').Host; Resolve-DnsName -Name $pacHost -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host 'PAC host resolved successfully.' } catch { Write-Host 'PAC host DNS resolution failed.' }
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'PAC host resolved successfully.', set variables.pac_host_resolved = true, else set variables.pac_host_resolved = false
steps.quote: Verify DNS resolution for the PAC file host to ensure the autoconfig URL is reachable.

steps.action: Check existing WinHTTP proxy settings to understand the current configuration.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Direct access (no proxy server).', set variables.proxy_not_set = true, else set variables.proxy_not_set = false
steps.quote: Check existing WinHTTP proxy settings to understand the current configuration.

steps.action: Set the corporate proxy autoconfig URL using the provided PAC file.
steps.quote: Set the corporate proxy autoconfig URL using the provided PAC file.

steps.action: Test connectivity to the internal gateway portal to verify the new proxy configuration.
steps.input: try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri '{{entities.portal_url}}' -UseBasicParsing -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host 'Status Code: ' + $response.StatusCode } catch { Write-Host 'Connection failed or error occurred.' }
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains 'Status Code: 200', set variables.portal_reachable = true. If stdout contains 'Status Code: 407', set variables.proxy_auth_required = true. Else set variables.portal_reachable = false
steps.quote: Test connectivity to the internal gateway portal to verify the new proxy configuration.
